rationale: Salesforce developers routinely encounter permission configuration walls when building automated integrations — a pain corroborated by Stack Exchange question volume, Trailblazer Community threads, and AppExchange tooling spend. Willingness-to-pay is evidenced by existing paid integration middleware (MuleSoft, Workato, Zapier) charging $500–$2,000+/month, and AppExchange diagnostic/admin tools selling at $20–$99/user/month, confirming the Salesforce ecosystem pays for configuration relief. The pain is real and recurring, though the single-source discovery signal warrants moderate (not burning) severity classification pending broader triangulation.
